96: 5. record mismatches in layout, hierarchy, typography, color, density, content, and state;
97: 6. fix the shared cause (token/component/layout), not one screenshot; and
98: 7. recapture until blocking mismatches are gone.
99: 
100: Use image diff/perceptual metrics where practical, but never let a metric replace visual
101: inspection. Dynamic text and platform font rasterization require masks/tolerances. The
102: minimum evidence is a named screenshot for every required route × theme × form-factor row,
103: plus a report mapping each image to the reference used.
104: 
105: ## 6. Completion gate
106: 
107: Do not call the UI complete unless all are true:
108: 
109: - [ ] Every reference destination and meaningful state is implemented.
110: - [ ] All controls perform the real product action or expose an honest unavailable state.
111: - [ ] The complete screenshot matrix exists and has been inspected.
112: - [ ] No stock scaffold/template styling remains.
113: - [ ] No visible borders/dividers/layout shadows violate the Flat 2.0 standard.
114: - [ ] Light/dark and phone/desktop maintain the same information architecture.
115: - [ ] Keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, text-scaling, and reduced-motion checks pass.
116: - [ ] Refresh/relaunch proves durable state where the reference implies persistence.
117: - [ ] A clean-checkout launch reproduces the same UI without ignored local artifacts.
118: - [ ] Responsible templates/scaffolds carry the same repair.
